decision: Only a treating doctor creates a Case File; there is never a Case File without an owner.
No separate chair role: the MDT Coordinator does the chair's job.
The MDT Coordinator.

Part of the treating doctor's team. The treating doctor adds them to each Case File (own department or other departments); they join with a code; role-based limited access; they cannot sign documents, as in PACS systems. Each treating doctor has at least one resident.
Join the meeting from anywhere, phones included, with a six-digit code. On phones a call option opens the phone dialer with the person's number.
source: Notes on 'board heads' and the plan (16 Oct)

decision: At the end each board member gets a pop-up to give a summary or suggestions: text only in the first build of the new interface; voice comes later, when the owner says (17 Oct).
